zh: 先看左邊的輸入平面與三個點，再看中間三位元編碼的立方體，最後對照三個星號：每個點最後都住進立方體的一個角；右邊是分數、階梯規則、位元與編碼的定義。〔功能：1、3〕
輸入平面與編碼立方體：點 ①②③ 的編碼分別是 110、000、011，各住進立方體的一個角。
en: First see the input plane with its three points on the left, then the cube of three-bit codes in the middle, and finally match the three marks: every point ends up in one corner of the cube; the right gives the definitions of score, step rule, bit and code. [Function: 1, 3]
Input plane and code cube: points ①②③ have codes 110, 000, 011 and each lives in one corner of the cube.

zh: 先看三條橘色邊界和旁邊的箭頭（箭頭指向分數為正的一側），再讀每一塊的三位元編碼；右邊以點 (1, 1) 算出編碼 110。七種編碼出現，101 不出現。線上的點依階梯規則記 0。〔功能：1、3〕
三條線 g₁ = x₁、g₂ = x₂、g₃ = −x₁ + x₂ − 1 切出七塊地，七種編碼出現，101 不出現。
en: First see the three orange boundaries and the arrows beside them (pointing to the side of positive scores), then read the three-bit code of each plot; the right computes the code 110 of the point (1, 1). Seven codes occur and 101 does not. A point on a line gets 0 by the step rule. [Function: 1, 3]
Three lines g₁ = x₁, g₂ = x₂, g₃ = −x₁ + x₂ − 1 cut seven plots; seven codes occur and 101 does not.

zh: 先看前三格各畫出一個條件的區域，再看第四格把三塊疊起來，沒有共同的部分；下方是矛盾的推理與實際碼、虛擬碼的定義。〔功能：1、3〕
編碼 101 的三個條件 x₁ > 0、x₂ ≤ 0、x₂ > x₁ + 1 沒有共同部分。
en: First see in the first three panels the region of each condition, then in the fourth panel the three stacked with no common part; below are the reasoning for the contradiction and the definitions of realized and unrealized codes. [Function: 1, 3]
The three conditions of code 101, x₁ > 0, x₂ ≤ 0, x₂ > x₁ + 1, have no common part.

zh: 先看八個角的顏色，與第 2 節平面上各區域相同；再看 101 是空心圓，沒有輸入會到達；右邊是輸出分數與切一刀的說明。〔功能：1、3〕
編碼立方體：8 個角對應 8 種編碼，101 是空心圓；輸出分數 q 的平面 q = 0 把角分成兩邊。
en: First see the colors of the eight corners, which match the cells of the plane in section 2; then see that 101 is a hollow circle that no input reaches; the right explains the output score and the single cut. [Function: 1, 3]
Code cube: 8 corners for the 8 codes, 101 hollow; the plane q = 0 of the output score splits the corners into two sides.

zh: 先看切面 q = 0，再看 A（圓點）在切面一側、B（方點）在另一側；每個角旁標出編碼與分數，右邊是逐角計分表。〔功能：2、3〕
en: First see the cut q = 0, then see A (circles) on one side and B (squares) on the other; each corner shows its code and score, and the right is the corner-by-corner score table. [Function: 2, 3]
The cut q = 0 and the corner scores: A at 000, 001, 011 and B at 010, 100, 110, 111, separated by one cut.

zh: 先看藍色的 A 區與橘色的 B 區，再看穿過 B 區的虛線 PQ（兩個 A 點的連線）；右邊是聯集與凸的定義和迷思。〔功能：1、3〕
A 區是 000、001、011 三塊併成的，連線 PQ 經過 B 塊的 R，所以不是凸的。
en: First see the blue region A and the orange region B, then the dashed line PQ through region B (the segment between two A points); the right gives the definitions of union and convex and the myth. [Function: 1, 3]
Region A is the union of 000, 001, 011, and the segment PQ passes through the B plot at R, so it is not convex.

zh: 先看左圖依第二組標籤上色，再看中間立方體底面的四個角，最後看右邊攤平的底面：A 在 000、110，B 在 010、100，沿對角交錯。〔功能：1、3〕
第二組標籤 A = {000, 110, 111}：底面四個角 A、B 沿對角交錯，XOR 又出現。
en: First see the plane colored by the second labelling on the left, then the four bottom corners of the cube in the middle, and finally the flattened bottom face on the right: A at 000, 110 and B at 010, 100, alternating along the diagonal. [Function: 1, 3]
Second labelling A = {000, 110, 111}: the four bottom corners alternate A and B along the diagonal, and XOR returns.

zh: 先看兩條對角線，再看它們交在同一個中點 M；右邊的推導說明 q(M) 不可能同時為正又不大於 0。〔功能：2、3〕
兩條對角線 000—110 與 010—100 共用中點 M：a₁ + a₂ + 2a₀ 既要 > 0 又要 ≤ 0。
en: First see the two diagonals, then see that they meet at the same midpoint M; the derivation on the right shows that q(M) cannot be both positive and at most 0. [Function: 2, 3]
The diagonals 000—110 and 010—100 share the midpoint M: a₁ + a₂ + 2a₀ must be both > 0 and ≤ 0.

zh: 先看三個立方體各切下哪個目標角（綠色星號：110、111、000），平面分別是 y₁ + y₂ − y₃ = 1.5、y₁ + y₂ + y₃ = 2.5、−y₁ − y₂ − y₃ = −0.5；再看它們合起來認出整個 A 集合。〔功能：1、3〕
切下單一個角：三個平面分別只切下 110、111、000。
en: First see which target corner each of the three cubes cuts off (green stars: 110, 111, 000) with the planes y₁ + y₂ − y₃ = 1.5, y₁ + y₂ + y₃ = 2.5, −y₁ − y₂ − y₃ = −0.5; then see that together they recognise the whole A set. [Function: 1, 3]
Cutting off single corners: three planes cut off only 110, 111, 000.

zh: 先看一條線段的 2 個角，再看正方形的 4 個角與立方體的 8 個角，每多一位元角數加倍；右邊是一般寫法。〔功能：1、3〕
從線段到立方體：2、4、8 個角，p 條線的編碼住在 2ᵖ 個角。
en: First see the 2 corners of a segment, then the 4 corners of a square and the 8 corners of a cube, doubling with every extra bit; the right gives the general form. [Function: 1, 3]
From a segment to a cube: 2, 4, 8 corners; codes of p lines live in 2ᵖ corners.

zh: 左邊是題 1：沒有任何輸入得到 101，所以指定 A 或 B 都不影響預測；右邊是題 2：兩個和與 a₃ 無關，矛盾依舊，各附核對。〔功能：1、2〕
兩題小練習與解題示範：101 不影響預測；只改 a₃ 消除不了底面的矛盾。
en: The left is Q1: no input gets 101, so assigning A or B changes no prediction; the right is Q2: both sums are independent of a₃ and the contradiction stays, each with its check. [Function: 1, 2]
Two exercises with worked answers: 101 changes no prediction; changing only a₃ cannot remove the bottom-face contradiction.
